config.label: OAuth client ID override
config.description: OAuth client ID override. Defaults to the built-in official client, so most users never set this.

config.label: OAuth client secret, only needed for confidential clients
config.description: OAuth client secret, only needed for confidential clients.

config.label: OAuth provider base URL
config.description: OAuth provider base URL. Defaults to GENCY_API_URL.

config.label: serve-http only: OAuth client IDs whose tokens this server accepts (space or comma separated)
config.description: serve-http only: OAuth client IDs whose tokens this server accepts (space or comma separated). Empty accepts any client.

config.label: serve-http only: HMAC key for signed upload handles
config.description: serve-http only: HMAC key for signed upload handles. Only needed when running more than one instance, so a handle issued by one verifies on another.

config.label: RFC 8707 resource indicator to send on authorize/token/refresh requests
config.description: RFC 8707 resource indicator to send on authorize/token/refresh requests. Opt-in until the Gency authorization server is confirmed to accept it.
